title: A pin or digest by dated exclude
assertion: An exact pin or digest enters young under a security-fix exclude with an advisory that covers its whole young window and lasts at most seven days, or unprovable or off the default branch under a reasoned exclude of at most seven days and still at least three days old by every time read; a Docker Hub digest found on no tag enters under no exclude; an image's advisory is held for form only, with the package and version it fixes; an expired one fails only where the list is edited
noFileReason: The exception lists are written in synthetic trees; GitHub's and Docker Hub's answers are synthetic and recorded; no file.
